title: 3 questions to ask before you book a family holiday

items.head: What does each person actually want?
items.body: Kids, parents, grandparents. **Plan one thing for everyone.**

items.head: How much travel time per day?
items.body: Long road days drain kids and elders. **Keep transfers short.**

items.head: Is the hotel really family-friendly?
items.body: Check connecting rooms, food options and **how far it is from everything.**

cta.line:
Planning a family trip?
Tell us who's coming.
